title: 第161章 巫器 噬界第160章 三级巫器
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 龙头的右手在杖身上轻轻一弹。
杖身震动了一下，发出一声清越的嗡鸣。
那声音不像是木头能发出的，更像是什么金属在震颤。
嗡鸣声在大厅里回荡了好几秒才缓缓消散，每一声回响都会在空气中激起一圈极淡的翠绿色涟漪。
“自吸收。”龙头说，“三级巫器才有的特性。不需要使用者主动灌注魔力，它会自己吸收周围的木属性能量粒子储存起来。战斗的时候，储存在杖身里的能量可以一次性释放出去。等于是多了一重免费的魔力储备。”
他把法杖翻了个面，让杖底朝上。
杖底截面上的年轮纹路在光纹映照下格外清晰，每一圈年轮都流转着极淡的翠绿色光芒。
“而且这根法杖还能成长。”龙头的声音顿了一下，“以后你要是弄到了更高品质的树芯和木属性辅材，让法杖吞噬了，它能继续往上进化。现在只是三级中上品，吞噬足够多的材料之后，冲上五级、六级也不是不可能。当然，前提是你能活到那个时候。”
把法杖往空中一抛。
法杖在半空中翻转了两圈，朝伊森飞过来。
伊森伸手接住。
杖身入手微沉，大概二十来斤。
触感温润，木质纤维贴合掌心，像握着一根还在生长的树枝。
手感，棒极了。
他试着往法杖里注入一丝魔力。
魔力刚触碰到杖身表面，就被吸了进去。
吸收的速度极快，快到他的魔力刚输出就被吞得干干净净。
翠绿色的光芒从漩涡图案中涌出来，沿着木质纹理朝杖头蔓延。
光芒所过之处，空气开始震颤。
一股浓郁的木属性能量波动从法杖内部扩散开来，震得大厅穹顶上的光点都在微微发颤。
伊森收回魔力。
光芒消散，法杖又恢复了那副普普通通的模样。
“好。”他说。
噬能虫从他头顶探出半个身子，一条前肢戳了戳他的脑门，“就一个好字？这可是三级巫器！老娘欠了七百八十三魔晶的辅材债，还欠了10魔晶的手工费，加在一起快八百魔晶了！你就一个好字？”
伊森将法杖收进储物戒指，“多谢大人。”
噬能虫的翅膀振动频率慢了几分。它从他头顶飞起来，悬在半空中，复眼盯着伊森的脸看了好几秒，最后发出一声闷闷的哼声，“算了，不跟你计较。”
三体巫师靠在椅背上。
深青色的长袍皱巴巴地裹在身上，领口敞得更开了。
龙头的嘴角还挂着那个收不住的笑容，但竖瞳里的光芒已经开始涣散。
蛟头的须子垂在桌面上，软塌塌的，不再摆动。
蛇头直接歪在肩膀一侧，信子从嘴角滑出来，搭在桌沿上一动不动。
他累极了。
但眼睛里全是满足。
世界树树芯本身的品质就碾压星核碎片，辅材的搭配也堪称完美，炼制过程虽然同样艰难，但那种艰难是可控的、有迹可循的艰难。
每一次能量炉的波动，每一次符文回路的调整，每一次木质纤维的重组，都在他九百年的经验积累下精准地推进。
他不仅炼成了这件法杖。
他对巫器炼制的理解也在这次炼制中突破了。
蛇头嘴里嘟囔了一句含混不清的话。
分叉的信子在桌面上弹了一下，又软塌塌地垂下去。
噬能虫从伊森头顶飞起来，落在石桌上，一条前肢戳了戳蛇头的鼻尖，“老东西，你说什么？”
蛇头没有回应。它的竖瞳已经合上了一半。
蛟头勉强抬起来，深蓝色的眼珠在噬能虫身上停了一下，“他说......值了。”
content_en:
The dragon's right hand flicked the staff lightly.
The staff vibrated and made a clear buzzing sound.
The sound didn't sound like wood, but more like some metal vibrating.
The buzzing sound echoed in the hall for several seconds before slowly dissipating. Each echo would stir up a faint emerald green ripple in the air.
"Self-absorption." Longtou said, "This is a characteristic only found in third-level witchcraft. It does not require the user to actively infuse magic power. It will absorb the surrounding wood energy particles and store them. During combat, the energy stored in the staff can be released at once. It is equivalent to an extra layer of free magic power reserve."
He turned the staff over so that the base was facing up.
The growth ring pattern on the cross-section of the bottom of the staff is particularly clear under the light pattern, and each growth ring is shining with a very faint emerald green light.
"And this staff can still grow." Longtou's voice paused, "If you get higher-quality tree cores and wood-attribute auxiliary materials in the future and let the staff devour it, it will continue to evolve. It is only the upper-middle grade of the third level. After swallowing enough materials, it is not impossible to rush to the fifth or sixth level. Of course, the premise is that you can survive until that time."
Throw the staff into the air.
The staff flipped twice in mid-air and flew towards Ethan.
Ethan reached out and caught it.
The stick is slightly heavy in the hand, weighing about twenty pounds.
It feels warm and moist to the touch, and the wood fiber fits the palm of your hand, like holding a branch that is still growing.
Feels great.
He tried to inject a little magic into the staff.
As soon as the magic power touched the surface of the staff, it was sucked in.
The absorption speed was extremely fast, so fast that his magic power was completely swallowed up as soon as he outputted it.
Emerald green light emerges from the swirling pattern and spreads along the wooden texture towards the head of the staff.
Wherever the light passed, the air began to tremble.
A strong wave of wood-attributed energy spread from the inside of the staff, causing the light spots on the dome of the hall to tremble slightly.
Ethan takes back his magic power.
The light dissipated and the staff returned to its ordinary appearance.
"Okay." He said.
The Energy Devouring Insect poked his forehead with one of its forelimbs, "Just one good word? This is a third-level witchcraft! I owe 783 magic crystals for auxiliary materials, and I also owe 10 magic crystals for crafting fees, which adds up to almost 800 magic crystals! You only have one good word?"
Ethan put the staff into the storage ring, "Thank you, sir."
The energy-devouring insect's wings vibrate at a slightly slower frequency. It flew up from above his head and hung in the air. His compound eyes stared at Ethan's face for several seconds, and finally let out a muffled hum, "Forget it, I won't argue with you."
The three-body wizard leaned back in his chair.
The dark blue robe was crumpled around her body, and the neckline was even more open.
The irrepressible smile still hangs on the corner of Longtou's mouth, but the light in his vertical pupils has begun to fade.
The whiskers of the dragon's head hang down on the table, soft and no longer swaying.
The snake's head was tilted directly to the side of his shoulder. Nobuko slipped out from the corner of his mouth and rested on the edge of the table motionless.
He was very tired.
But his eyes were full of satisfaction.
The quality of the World Tree core itself is superior to that of star core fragments, and the combination of auxiliary materials is also perfect. Although the refining process is equally difficult, the difficulty is controllable and traceable.
Every fluctuation of the energy furnace, every adjustment of the rune circuits, and every reorganization of the wood fibers are all accurately advanced based on his nine hundred years of experience.
He not only refined this staff.
His understanding of witchcraft refining also made a breakthrough during this refining.
The snakehead muttered something vague.
The forked letter bounced on the table and then hung limply.
The energy-devouring insect flew up from above Ethan's head and landed on the stone table. One of its forelimbs poked the tip of the snake's head, "Old man, what did you say?"
The smuggler didn't respond. Its vertical pupils have been half closed.
The dragon head reluctantly raised its head, and its dark blue eyes paused on the energy-devouring insect. "He said...it was worth it."
